mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(asset_id) FROM asset WHERE is_deleted = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(asset_id) FROM asset WHERE status = #{status} AND is_deleted = 'N'

SELECT category, COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'MAINTENANCE_REQUIRED' THEN 1 END) as maintenanceRequiredCount FROM asset WHERE is_deleted = 'N' AND category IN ('TRACTOR', 'COMBINE', 'RICE_PLANT', 'TRANSPORT', 'LOADER') GROUP BY category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
